settings.title: Pi Plugin Settings
settings.piPath.name: Pi binary path
settings.piPath.desc: Full path to the pi executable. Default: pi (uses PATH)
settings.nodePath.name: Node bin directory (optional)
settings.nodePath.desc: Directory containing the node binary. Leave empty for auto-detection. Needed when GUI apps can't find node (nvm/fnm users).
settings.rpcTimeout.name: RPC timeout (seconds)
settings.rpcTimeout.desc: Timeout for RPC requests to Pi. Increase for slow operations like model switching.
settings.workingDir.name: Working directory
settings.workingDir.desc: Working directory for Pi (empty = parent folder of vault). Note: Not supported on mobile.
settings.sessionDir.name: Session save directory
settings.persistSessions.name: Persist sessions
settings.persistSessions.desc: Automatically save conversations as vault notes
settings.thinkingLevel.name: Thinking level
settings.thinkingLevel.desc: Level of thinking/reasoning for the model
settings.defaultProvider.name: Default provider
settings.defaultModel.name: Default model
